name: smwmusic-rockman-exe-n1-battle-navi-battle-wonderswan-colour
title: Rockman.exe N1 Battle - Navi Battle (Wonderswan Colour version)
description:
This is the battle theme from Rockman.exe N1 Battle for the WonderSwan Colour. This uses samples, but they're small. Except for the drums, the samples are extremely tiny and looped.

Original by Yusuke Beppu.

Is this the first WonderSwan Colour port in this website?

The drums were ripped from Little Nicky on the Game Boy Colour.
